verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken layout: 'SOLSTICE PRESENTS' sits below the event details, the URL line comes before the time/venue, the text stack is jammed together with uneven left/centre alignment, and the RSVP CTA has shrunk to a tiny pill mixed in with the badges at the bottom, so the call to action is buried. There's also a big empty band under the phone. The only difference is the decorative circle: A keeps the original's large circle behind the headline, while B shrinks it to an odd little blob in the corner, so A stays slightly closer to the original.
